title: UX-01: adopt the UX/UI standard and build the technical design system (tokens, components, Storybook, Chromium evidence)
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Built packages/design-system from docs/vision/UX_UI_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md (decision D17): DTCG 2025.10 subset tokens in primitive, semantic (Paper and Ink), component and card layers with exact standard values; validator for references, cycles, types, units, constructs, descriptions, theme mappings, achromatic neutrals and 38 contrast pairs per theme; Style Dictionary 5.6.0 resolution cross-checked against the validator; deterministic CSS, typed TS, renderer (sRGB and linear), @value breakpoints, font faces and manifest with a drift check.

Foundation and components: DesignSystemProvider (theme, density, motion, locale, single announcer), versioned preference model with the standard's defaults and safe device storage, externalized strings with plurals and the en-XA pseudolocale; self-hosted Source Sans 3 3.052R (OFL-1.1) with fallback metrics measured from the release TTFs against Liberation Sans; 46 experimental React Aria components with CSS Modules, exact generated CSS-module types and section 13 documentation contracts, including Confirmation, CardTile, DeckEntry, CardInspector, InspectorHost, CardFaceText and FanContentNotice.

Enforcement and evidence: style-ownership gate over the design system and apps/web (raw colours, fonts, sizes, shadows, radii, durations, lengths, z-index, !important and unknown tokens rejected; 10 documented exceptions); component-contract gate with 190/190 state coverage; Storybook 10.6.1 with toolbar globals; Playwright and axe Chromium suite in a new CI stage design-system-browser.
apps/web now renders inside DesignSystemProvider with design-system components, token-only styling and the fan-content notice; global.css removed; allowArbitraryExtensions enabled.

Dependencies pinned in packages/design-system at planned register versions (style-dictionary 5.6.0, storybook and @storybook/react-vite 10.6.1, vite 8.3.2, @vitejs/plugin-react 6.1.2, @playwright/test 1.63.0, @axe-core/playwright 4.13.0, typescript 6.0.3, @types/node 24.19.1). esbuild's postinstall denied (allowBuilds esbuild: false) in favour of the lockfile-pinned platform binary. Decision D16 adds CC-BY-4.0 to scripts/ci/policy.json for Storybook's caniuse-lite. pnpm audit reports no advisories. ESLint ignores storybook-static; Storybook builds into .local.

ADR 0017, design-system runbook, validation record, archived original ZIP, decisions D16/D17, backlog UX-01/UX-03 statuses, R25 requirement links (statuses unchanged), F-DESIGN-SYSTEM and F-WEB, documentation map, dated notes in the CI runbook, fan-content policy and web README, status lines and handoff.

RUN-20261020-020 design-system gates 30/30; RUN-20261020-021 Chromium suite 150/150 (88 axe runs over 44 stories in Paper and Ink, 38 target-size checks, 23 interaction checks, 1 index check); RUN-20261020-022 typecheck, lint and full suite (399 Node, 24 Python, upstream 406/1 skip, 2 injection). RUN-018 is superseded and RUN-019 failed source_changed because a Storybook build sat in the source tree; Storybook now builds into .local.

RUN-20261020-023 (isolated pipeline) failed at the foundation stage: scripts/verify-config.py pinned allowBuilds to an empty map, and RUN-20261020-022 had not run pnpm verify. The configuration contract now requires exactly the reviewed denial {esbuild: false}. RUN-20261020-024 (Chromium 150/150) and RUN-20261020-025 (configuration contract, typecheck, lint, full suite: 399 Node, 24 Python, upstream 406/1 skip, 2 injection) pass at the final fingerprint 686eb1c8.
RUN-20261020-026: isolated pipeline passed all 15 stages (including the new design-system-browser stage) in 612 s with exact timing at fingerprint 686eb1c8.
